response: CLR relative to the geometric mean of 200 prevalent genera; pseudocount 0.5 reads
method: Site-mean CLR ~ MAT + MAP/12 + measured S, separately by compartment; standardized ridge alpha=10; 200 site bootstraps; five contiguous longitude validation blocks.
limitations: Spatial associations, not causal forecasts. Root-adjacent enrichment does not establish a plant selective mechanism or plant growth. Bootstrap ranges omit raster and model-structure uncertainty. Group selection uses the full cohort; validation is conditional on the selected groups.
hallmark_selection: Six most abundant genera among the 200 prevalent genera, plus the existing CSP1-2 indicator.
plant_selection: Five largest positive root-adjacent versus surface CLR displacements, also positive versus deep soil, with at least 20% prevalence; descriptive indicators, not individually significance-tested.
